description.value: Urban Farm Market is a fruit and vegetable store located on Westminster Highway in Richmond, BC. It operates as a small farm-market format shop, the kind of stop a touring cyclist might seek out for fresh produce along a route. Its social media presence is minimal and has seen little activity since 2022.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record has minimal tags (name and shop=farm only). The Facebook page provides an address (11900 Westminster Hwy, Richmond, BC V6X 1B3) and phone (604-279-8845) and categorizes the business as a 'Fruit & Vegetable Store,' which supports the Groceries category. However, the Facebook page shows zero reviews, only 11 likes/followers, no posts available, and the most recent photo dates from August 2022, raising concerns about whether the business is still actively operating.
